title: The web chat's ownRun ref and the module erasing copy are a hidden mode, owed by PR 1311; not a pattern to copy
evidence: widget-src/src/hooks/useChatState.ts (ownRun: whether this tab's erase ran since the last move, read from the page's erasing prop) and widget-src/src/lib/chat-history-access.ts (erasing, set by whileErasing around deleteUserData) copy useErase's erasing mode. They are owed by PR 1311 until useErase (master/austin's file) emits the erase move together with whether it was this tab's. N4: a remote erase landing during this tab's own erase, which is then refused, shows no chat words: ownRun counts the move as this tab's own.
